name: Rev Laundry Soap
headline: Fuel your freshness.
intro: All-natural laundry soaps, scent boosters and re-usable dryer sheets, made and bottled in Columbia, Louisiana.
about: At Rev Laundry we take laundry seriously. We use only the highest quality ingredients — for the soaps that leave your clothes clean and refreshed, and for the scent boosters and re-usable laundry sheets. We don't use crazy chemicals and cover them up with artificial colours and chemically rendered scents. We pride ourselves on keeping your clothes clean and in top shape, while protecting your manly image. Can't have the guys noticing your clothes smell like gardenias, can we?
menuNote: Soaps come in 32 fl oz bottles and are safe for all fabrics.
footerLine: Made and bottled in Columbia, Louisiana.
